total_note: Everything priced so far, for the four of you
intro: All four hotels are booked. Here is everything in between for the four of you, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks it in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: Six transfers on Paros, Santorini and Athens
transfers.note: Paros port to Parilio, Parilio to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport, Athens airport to One&Only Aesthesis, and Aesthesis to Athens airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver. Your Mykonos airport and port transfers come free with Cali.

boats.title: Mykonos to Paros on a private yacht, with swim stops
boats.note: A 59 ft Azimut 55 flybridge with captain and host. A covered aft deck with a dining table for shade, one of the largest flybridges in its class, sunbeds on the foredeck, and an air-conditioned salon and three cabins below for a rest out of the sun. Snorkel and fishing gear, cheeses, cold cuts and fresh fruit, soft drinks, beer and wine, towels and wifi, fuel included. Your luggage comes with you.

photo.alt: A white Azimut 55 flybridge yacht under way over turquoise water
photo.caption: Your yacht for the day, the Azimut 55

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini on the Blue Star Delos
ferries.note: Moved off the high-speed catamaran onto the Blue Star Delos, one of the big conventional ferries that carry cars, so the crossing is much steadier. Departs Paros 11:45am, arrives Santorini 2:50pm, business seats for four. A driver meets you at the port for Andronis Arcadia.

optional_title: Other yachts for the Mykonos to Paros day

optional.title: Sunseeker Manhattan 60 flybridge
optional.note: A 64 ft Sunseeker with a flybridge, foredeck sunbeds and a hydraulic swim platform at the stern, plus a Seabob. Replaces the Azimut.

photo.alt: A white Sunseeker Manhattan flybridge yacht at anchor over turquoise water
photo.caption: The Sunseeker Manhattan 60

optional.title: Aicon 72 hardtop
optional.note: The largest of the three at 76 ft, with a big foredeck sunbathing area, a separate aft dining space, a wide swim platform, a Williams tender and a Seabob. It also has a Seakeeper gyrostabilizer, which noticeably cuts the rolling at sea, so it is the steadiest ride of the three. Replaces the Azimut.

photo.alt: An Aicon 72 yacht at anchor in a clear turquoise bay below a rocky shore
photo.caption: The Aicon 72

optional_note: Not in the total above. If you pick the Sunseeker or the Aicon instead of the Azimut, your total gets adjusted and the deposit goes towards the new balance.
fine_boat: The yacht: 30% of the charter confirms it. Cancelling 45 to 30 days before the day costs 50% of the charter, and inside 30 days 100%. If the captain or port authority cancels for weather or a technical problem, it is refunded. Fuel can move with the market; you hear about any change in advance.
how: The deposit is set by Original Senses under their terms: 30% of the yacht charter, 25% of the transfers and the ferry fare in full. The balance is due 30 days before you arrive. Yachts go fast in late June, so it is worth locking this in early.
pending_note: Updated for the Azimut, with the Santorini to Athens flight off since you are booking it yourselves. Original Senses is reissuing the payment link to match; I will send it over as soon as it comes through.
